story.title: PB Fintech Says AI Will Transform Insurance Claims Processing as Paisabazaar Enters Debt Broking
story.summary: PB Fintech, the parent company of Policybazaar and Paisabazaar, announced in its Q4 FY26 results that artificial intelligence will fundamentally transform how insurance claims are processed for Indian consumers, while also revealing that Paisabazaar has entered the debt broking segment. The company launched expanded insurance coverage categories including gym memberships, OPD consultations and maternity, areas where AI-driven assessment could streamline previously manual approval processes. The dual announcement signals PB Fintech's strategy to use AI not only for customer acquisition but for the full claims lifecycle, which directly affects how quickly and accurately Indian policyholders receive payouts.
